description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Application' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Startup' namespace. The class extends a system controller and defines the 'index' method, which initializes various core components such as URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, cart, and loads validation helpers. It serves as a startup or bootstrap controller that sets up essential services for the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing core services during the admin panel startup process in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes core components such as URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart services, and loads validation helpers to bootstrap the admin application.
